_readme: Edit the words for any scene here, then run: python tools/build.py. 'line' is the short caption shown on cards and scene pages. 'alt' describes the photo for screen readers and search. 'moods' drive the shop filters: coast, water, mountains, canyon, road, wild.

SC-001.line: White water folding over the rocks where the land runs out. The shore at its loudest.
SC-001.alt: Waves breaking into white foam around a rocky Big Sur headland, deep blue ocean beyond.

SC-002.line: A long look down the cliff edge, where blue water keeps working the rocks.
SC-002.alt: Looking down a rocky Big Sur shoreline where deep blue and turquoise water meets boulders and cliff.

SC-003.line: Headland after headland, fading into the haze. The kind of view that makes you pull over.
SC-003.alt: Big Sur coastline of green headlands, coves and turquoise water stretching into haze, pines in the foreground.

SC-004.line: A ribbon of fresh water falling straight onto the sand. Big Sur showing off.
SC-004.alt: A waterfall dropping onto a small sandy cove with turquoise surf, framed by cliffs and cypress trees.

SC-005.line: Joshua trees and a hillside lit up gold. The desert, briefly in bloom.
